evidence: We are exploring the integration of artificial intelligence technologies (AI) into our operations.

The deployment of AI, which relies on substantial data volumes, introduces risks such as potential leakage of confidential or proprietary information, unauthorized access, misuse, or theft of sensitive data.
the possibility of competitors adopting AI more effectively, which could materially impact our business, financial condition, results of operations, or market share.
third-party service providers may independently implement AI solutions, which could further complicate our risk landscape.
ai_positioning.summary: HLI explore l'intégration de l'IA dans ses opérations mais adopte une posture défensive, mettant l'accent sur les risques de sécurité des données, de fuite d'informations confidentielles et de concurrence accrue.
